verdicts.reason: A: The skates are cropped so tightly at the top that you only see a blade, and the arrow cuts straight across the boot. Circle decorations sit on the blade, and the offer block has broken apart: 'USE CODE' runs into the divider lines, 'TO GET A DISCOUNT' sits lower than 'USE CODE', and '50% OFF' is tiny and stranded. The headline and CTA are still clean and readable. B: 'ICE RINK' is placed on top of the skate blade, and a row of circle decorations plus the divider lines are piled onto the boot. The offer text is pushed against the top-right corner with its first line touching the skate. The CTA button runs into the right edge, and 'LINK IN BIO' is tiny and off-centre. The hierarchy and grouping are a mess.
